verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI ships as an official Python library with a documented async API (AsyncWebCrawler / arun) that developers build against directly. It is complemented by a Dockerized FastAPI server and a playground that generates request code. Missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs in languages beyond Python, an official client SDK for the hosted server API, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
